hero.p: Software Engineer with enterprise background, building scalable back-end systems, intuitive front-end interfaces, and thoughtful UI/UX. Open to full-time or freelance opportunities — explore my work and let’s create something exceptional.

bio.intro: I’m a software engineer with over 5 years of experience, ranging from small non-profits to large tech companies with ambitious goals.

career.p: I thrive on tackling diverse challenges, from designing and developing intuitive UI/UX components to building production-grade backend services in collaboration with Agile teams. Whether I’m solving problems through code, crafting elegant designs, or sketching out ideas on paper, I bring creativity and a commitment to quality that’s hard to match.

extra.p: Outside of work, I find inspiration through walking on nature, photography, traveling, and cultivating both my garden and my knowledge of sustainable agriculture. My curiosity and hunger for knowledge drive me to constantly learn and innovate. For me, creativity, work, and play are all deeply interconnected.
